reviews.text: Thank you so much for the 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We really appreciate you taking the time to rate our services. The whole team is delighted to know your experience with us was positive. 🐾💚 …
Incredible service from all the staff, especially Noemí, who treated Luna very well and made the visit the best it could be ☺️

Since Gordon arrived, his regular veterinarian has been at Clinica Veterinaria Patraix. They always offer the assistance and confidence my little one needs. The care is top-notch; kindness, professionalism, etc... in short: a 10 out of 10!
Friendly and highly professional. She's treating my Westie Darcy's recurrent ear infections, which is a complex issue to manage.
A really great vet! The staff are super nice; I took my puppy there and they treated him wonderfully and with great care, explaining everything really well. I'm going to keep taking my dog ​​there.

We are delighted with the entire team at this veterinary clinic.
They are very kind and explained everything we needed to know about our dog in detail, answering all our questions.
They are very loving and gentle with our puppy.

In April it was 13 years ago, and now it's been a few months since we got my Trufa (a small, very sweet mixed-breed dog ;) Passport, microchip, vaccinations... we've been going there ever since, and we've always been very well taken care of. I'm very happy with Ana's professionalism, her kindness, and that of her whole team—they're friendly, always smiling, and very pleasant. They explain everything, keep track of their pets' medical history, and even send appointment reminders via WhatsApp. Whenever we go, it's rare not to see people coming in or out with their animals. Thank you so much for your work and especially for your attention! ;) Best regards, Rebeca and Trufa!!

I arrived in desperation without an appointment because my dog, who has cancer, was very ill and another clinic hadn't given him any treatment. Ana treated him with great care and gave him palliative care to ease his suffering. She also referred us to an excellent oncologist, Pascual de Rojas, under whose supervision Sam, despite his advanced age, enjoys a more than acceptable quality of life.

Hi, I wanted to thank Noe and the whole team who took care of Yumi 🐈. A big thank you to Noe for being so patient and explaining in detail what she found with our kitten. Let's hope it's nothing serious. Best regards. Thank you so much 😻 …
They are very friendly and professional

I'm absolutely delighted with them 🌸
Every single one of the staff is so lovely, from the receptionist to the vet.

I take my cat Mia there, and they treat her with so much love that I know for sure this is my go-to clinic 🩷✨

Noe took great care of us. She dewormed my kittens, gave them antibiotics for their eyes, and prescribed the right food. She and her team are very friendly and professional. The service and communication via WhatsApp were excellent. A very good experience 🐈 Thank you ❤️
Very good facilities, very pleasant

I'm new to dogs, but Noemí, Valentina, and the other doctors at the center are wonderful.
They treat us great; Mel isn't afraid to go into the clinic and always feels at ease with the doctors.
They provide excellent service, give us all the necessary information, and respond super quickly.
Highly recommended!
A big hug to the whole team!
The attention and kindness with which they treat you is the best, and the care and gentleness with which they treat the pets is even better, thank you for your impeccable service 🫶🏻 …
They were always very attentive to my kittens and very empathetic with the owners. I recommend them 100%; they are excellent professionals.

I'm delighted! This is the first vet I've seen after several bad experiences where I feel completely at ease leaving my cat. The entire team has been attentive, professional, and respectful—they've treated us wonderfully!

Hello, thank you for taking the time to leave a review. At our center, we take the satisfaction of our patients and their families very seriously, as our goal is to improve every day. To that end, we always review each review, trying to identify the issue and learn from it.

However, after a thorough review of our database, we found no record of a service associated with this profile. This leads us to believe that this review may be an error or not based on a real experience at our clinic.

If you were indeed our patient, we invite you to contact us directly so we can assist you personally.

Best regards, Fran.

Good service and love for animals.
No waiting because there are several veterinarians.
They lack a good selection of accessories.
They don't have a dog grooming service, which is a shame because it's not possible to centralize all the services for my dog ​​in one place.
Overall, good.
Thanks Fernando for your great review. We hope to see you soon. ☺️

Charming, wonderful, caring, and with extraordinary service. Thank you for pampering Lady (she even loves coming in, haha!) and my granddaughter Luna. A truly professional team. You clearly love your work. Thank you!!
Thank you very much, Jose Angel, for your good rating and for your continued trust in Jackie.
We received excellent service today, I highly recommend them 😌😊 …

Thank you to the entire team of professionals at the center for taking such good care of Pipo and showing such attention and interest in his paw. It's clear you are true professionals and that the animals' well-being is your top priority. You made something that was causing me a lot of anxiety incredibly easy thanks to your calm and trustworthy approach. From the surgery to the checkups and treatments, everything has been so smooth and easy thanks to your friendly and personal service. I hope nothing serious happens, but if anything does, we would definitely bring Pipo back to your center. Thank you all so much!
